review_note: Drafted from public law and court practice. Must be reviewed and approved by the Directorate of Prosecution before use.
applies_to: Online financial fraud: impersonation calls, 'digital arrest', UPI/app fraud, investment scams

charges.label: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property

ingredients.text: The deception induced the victim to hand over money or property
Money or property was actually delivered
The accused pretended to be someone else (for example a police or CBI officer)
The person claimed does not exist or did not act
A threat of injury to person, reputation or property was made
The threat was meant to cause alarm or make the victim act

charges.label: Cheating by personation using a computer resource

ingredients.text: A phone, app or computer was used
The accused cheated by pretending to be someone else
Two or more people agreed to commit the offence

rules.text: Money received in an account is not enough to charge the account holder. Each account-holder accused needs at least one more independent link: SIM or device, KYC photo identified, CCTV of withdrawal, login IP, or their own statement.
Every electronic record relied on needs a BSA 63(4) certificate with Part A and Part B and a matching hash.
Record the statement of the bank's nodal officer who can prove the bank records in court.
Every search and seizure must be recorded by audio-video (eSakshya) with the recording linked to the seizure memo.

tasks.text: Report on the national portal (1930) and send hold requests to receiving banks
Ask telecom and platforms to block numbers, accounts and links
BNSS 94 notices to banks for statements, KYC and BSA 63(4) certificates
BNSS 94 notices to telecom for CDR and customer application forms
Request account details and IP logs from the messaging platform
Letter to the impersonated agency to confirm no such officer or action
Record the bank nodal officer's statement (BNSS 180)
Seize accused's phones, SIMs and cards with eSakshya recording (BNSS 105)
Send seized devices to the forensic lab with request for expert certificate
Inform the victim of progress within 90 days (BNSS 193(3)(ii))
